sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines 
 the equipment inspection checklist, which must be carried out every six 
 months and every year as indicated by M6/Y1 in the above title block
PCS: Process Control Unit

The first 
 draft initiated by eng: Gad El Mawla Mohamed Abd El Rahman, tested by eng Hany 
 Sobhy and eng. Abd El Salam Mohamed Abd El Salam, revised by quality control eng Abd EL Monaem AL Emam at EDEPC, 
 accepted by general director eng Tarek Youssef and approved by 
 eng. Mekhaael George Habashi Sector 
 inspector of Ayoun Moussa power station.

This document 
 accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil EDEPC MPIS Coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC 
 admin. & financial inspection & quality control's general director and 
 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.

Safety 
Precautions

A work order must be issued, the maintenance staff should be 
 qualified and carry the suitable safety ID category.

Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, anti static hand probe to 
avoid electrical shock, nose mouth dust cover, eye glasses ... 
etc

Work to 
be Carried Out

For 
standby unit, visually 
inspect the wiring connections. 
Retighten the wirings and cards every year.

Clean the following parts:
 Panel rack, Electronic cards, Edge cards, Door filter, Air fan

Check the power supply Must be
110 A.C 10 %
+ve 24 D.C 10 %
+ve 12 D.C 10 %
+ve 5 D.C 10 %

Transfer 
the stand by unit to service

Transfer the 
first to standby unit and repeat the previous steps from 1: 3
